title: Send reminder opens the send email window with every contact listed
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. Make sure 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' has its Send preventive maintenance notifications setting on, and a contact 'Dave Brabay' with an email address you can read (for example a QA mailbox) set as the preferred contact of unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402'.
  5. Give the customer two more contacts: 'Lisa Brabay' with an email address you can read, and 'Sam Brabay' with no email address.
  6. On the QA environment, send only to a mailbox the QA team controls.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). On unit 402's row press Contact, then press Send reminder on the contact card.
  2. Read the window's title and the Send to list.
  3. Check who is ticked, and try to tick Sam Brabay.
  4. Next to Sam Brabay press Add email; in Email for Sam Brabay type an address you can read and press Save. Try to tick Sam again.
  5. Find the Optional emails field and type one more address you can read.
  6. Press Cancel. Open the customer's Contacts tab and read Sam Brabay's details.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Send reminder opens the application's existing Send email window.
  • Send to lists every contact of the customer, each with a checkbox. Dave Brabay, the unit's preferred contact, is ticked and marked Preferred contact; Lisa Brabay is listed unticked.
  • Sam Brabay, who has no email, is listed unticked, cannot be ticked, and shows No email with Add email.
  • After Add email and Save, Sam Brabay can be ticked, and the address is saved on Sam's contact.
  • The Optional emails field takes further addresses.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S19; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R3: “Send reminder opens the application's existing send email dialog. Its recipients are the customer's contacts, each with a checkbox. The asset's preferred contact is ticked where it has an email address. A contact without one is listed unticked, cannot be ticked, and shows No email with Add email, which adds the address to that contact so it can then be ticked. The dialog's field takes further addresses”
